questions_and_answers.question_text: Wèi.

answers.answer_text: Hello.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wèi, shi Wàijiāobù ma?

answers.answer_text: Hello. Is this the Ministry of Foreign Affairs?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒ yào zhǎo Lín Sīzhǎng shuō huà.

answers.answer_text: I want to speak with Department Chief Lín.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nín shi nǎr a?

answers.answer_text: Who is this?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒ xìng Lěkèláiěr. Wǒ shi Fǎguo Dàshǐguǎnde Shāngwù Jīngjìguān.

answers.answer_text: My name is Leclaire. I am the Commercial/Economics Officer from the French Embassy.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nín děngyiděng, wǒ gěi nín kànkan tā zài bu zài.

answers.answer_text: Wait a moment. I'll see whether he is here or not.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wèi, tā zhèihuǐr bú zài. Nín yào liú ge huàr ma?

answers.answer_text: Hello. He is not here at the moment. Would you like to leave a message?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Láojià, tā huílaide shíhou, nín qǐng ta gěi wo dǎ ge diànhuà.

answers.answer_text: When he comes back, please ask him to give me a phone call.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Hǎo, qǐng nín bǎ nínde diànhuà hàomǎr gàosong wo. Wǒ xiěxialai.

answers.answer_text: All right. Please tell me your phone number. I'll write it down.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒde diànhuà shi wǔ èr yāo-sān sān yāo.

answers.answer_text: My phone number is 521-331.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Duìbuqǐ, nǐ gāngcái gěi wo dǎ diànhuà, wǒ bú zài.

answers.answer_text: I'm sorry. When you called me just now, I wasn't in.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ yǒu shì ma?

answers.answer_text: Can I help you with something?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì a! Wǒ nèitian gēn nín yuēhǎole míngtian shídiǎn dào nín bàngōngshì qu tántan.

answers.answer_text: Yes, you can. The other day I made an appointment with you to go to your office at ten o'clock tomorrow for a talk.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Yīnwei míngtian zǎoshang wǒ yǒu yíjiàn yàojǐnde shì, suǒyǐ xiǎng wèn nín wǒmen néng bu néng gǎi dào xiàwǔ.

answers.answer_text: Because I have an urgent business matter tomorrow morning, I want to ask you whether we can change it to the afternoon.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Xiàwǔ shénme shíhou?

answers.answer_text: What time in the afternoon?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nín kàn xiàwǔ sān-sìdiǎn zěnmeyàng? Duì nín fāngbian bu fāngbian?

answers.answer_text: What do you think of three or four in the afternoon? Is that convenient for you?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sìdiǎn bǐ sāndiǎn hǎo. Wǒ sāndiǎn zhōng děi kāi huì.

answers.answer_text: Four would be better than three. I have to attend a meeting at three o'clock.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Hǎo ba. Nà míngtian sìdiǎn zhōng jiàn.

answers.answer_text: All right. Well then, see you at four o'clock tomorrow.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Hǎo, wǒ sìdiǎn zhōng děng ni.

answers.answer_text: All right. I'll wait for you at four o'clock.
